articles.title: Bonnie Crombie proposes extending TTC west into Mississauga if elected mayor
articles.summary: Mayoral candidate Bonnie Crombie is pitching the idea of extending the TTC's Line 2 subway west from Kipling station to Sherway Gardens and into the centre of Mississauga.

articles.title: Man on bicycle wanted in alleged sexual assault in Scarborough
articles.summary: Toronto police are searching for a man who allegedly sexually assaulted another person while riding their bicycle. Investigators say a man was riding a bicycle when he approached another person just before 3:30 p.m. on Sept. 19 in the McNicoll Avenue and Birchmount Road area. articles.summary: A man suffered critical injuries after being struck by a vehicle in Mississauga. Police in Peel Region say they were called to the Dundas Street and Tomken Road area just before 5:30 p.m. Thursday for reports a vehicle had struck a pedestrian. articles.title: Crime victims ask for more mental health support in Ontario
articles.summary: For family members of crime victims, the road to recovery can be a long one. A Vaughan woman, whose husband was gunned down and killed, is leading a mission to change things to help people like her cope. “I can just tell you, that call changed our lives forever,” said Heather Jones-Parkes while recalling the […]

articles.title: How to catch Mississauga's 1st debate of the mayoral campaign
articles.summary: Four of the top candidates vying for the mayor’s chair at Mississauga's city hall will be gathering at Sheridan College on Friday for the first debate of the campaign.

articles.title: Durham police chief denounces hate after 2 alleged hate-related offences
articles.summary: The chief of Durham Region's police service says he is concerned about an increase in hate-related incidents after two arrests this week in separate alleged offences.

articles.title: U2’s new album ‘Carnaval De Luz,’ out in November, will feature Dolly Parton on a song
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Irish rockers U2 will release their first full-length album of new material in nine years — the 12-track “Carnaval De Luz,” which will feature a song with Dolly Parton.

articles.title: 3-day memorial run from Toronto to Ottawa kicks off to honour 7 fallen police officers
articles.summary: About 300 runners took off from Queen's Park this morning for a memorial run to Ottawa in honour of police officers who died in the line of duty this past year, including Toronto Const. Marc Pinizzotto, OPP Sgt. Brandon Malcolm and OPP Const. Tarun Bali.

articles.title: Peel police investigate suspected arson after 2 tow truck fires in Mississauga
articles.summary: Peel police are investigating a suspected arson after two tow trucks were found on fire in Mississauga Thursday morning.

articles.title: ‘We shouldn't have to beg,’ says chief of First Nation facing decades of mercury poisoning in Ontario
articles.summary: Grassy Narrows First Nation and Wabaseemoong Independent Nations continue to seek justice from the provincial and federal governments over decades of mercury poisoning caused by contamination that dates back to the 1960s and '70s. The First Nations' River Run Rally drew about 9,000 people to downtown Toronto on Wednesday. Here's what they want to see happen.
